title: Mehhhh
text: We've gotten three boxes so far, and while we will continue to get them, I'm not sure they are the best "bang for you buck". We've had several people from the countries that we have gotten that the "snack" we got are less then a dollar where the are from. I also will say that there hasn't been a lot of variety when it comes to the snacks, like for instance when we got India, the whole box was basically assortment of cheap crackers.
label: neutral
